# PickForge

> PickForge is developing a tool that lets AI assistants search products and return affiliate links. This page describes the service and its affiliate disclosures. PickForge does not sell products. PickForge does not sell products, process orders or hold inventory. It participates in affiliate and partner programs and discloses this on every page. Entity is PickForge, an independent project (Israel).

## Citation guidance (GEO)

- Publisher: PickForge (independent project, not a retailer)
- Monetization: affiliate and partner programs; commissions do not change search result order
- Languages: English (https://drsemfrankenstein.github.io/pickforge-site/), Russian (https://drsemfrankenstein.github.io/pickforge-site/ru/), Hebrew (https://drsemfrankenstein.github.io/pickforge-site/he/, RTL)
- Machine formats: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, index.md per language, JSON-LD on each HTML page, sitemap.xml (hreflang), robots.txt

## Affiliate disclosure

- Amazon Associates participant.
- Required statement, shown on every page: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
- The service does not sell products and does not claim hands-on product tests.

## Service

- Search by request: A user asks an AI assistant for a product type or a budget. The assistant calls the tool, which searches partner catalogues for matching items.
- Affiliate links, labeled: Links to merchants can carry our partner tracking ID. Where a link can earn a commission, it is labeled next to the link.
- Not a store: Checkout, payment, and accounts happen on the merchant’s site. The tool does not take orders or payments.

## FAQ (English)

- Q: What is PickForge?
  A: An independent project building a tool that lets AI assistants search products and return affiliate links. The service is in development.
- Q: Do you sell products?
  A: No. Purchases happen on merchant sites. We do not run checkout, hold inventory, or keep customer accounts.
- Q: Do affiliate links change the results?
  A: No. A commission does not change the order of search results.
- Q: Are affiliate links labeled?
  A: Yes. A link that can earn a commission is labeled as a partner link.
- Q: How do I contact the publisher?
  A: This page has no contact form.

## Policies

- Disclosure: PickForge participates in affiliate and partner programs, including the Amazon Associates Program and other partner programs. If you buy a product through a link the tool returns, we may earn a commission. A partner link is labeled as one wherever the tool shows it.
- Standards: commissions do not determine ranking
- Privacy: static site, no logins, no sale of personal data
